newsitem.title: LATVIA: BOURSE DRAWS UP NEW CAPITALISATION RULES.
newsitem.headline: BOURSE DRAWS UP NEW CAPITALISATION RULES.

text.p: The Riga stock exchange on Friday said that it has set rules for calculating market capitalisation, bringing it in line with international practice.
"We are thus making the capitalisation of our bourse companies comparable internationally," Uldis Cerps, the bourse president told a news conference.

The bourse said it was following the standard formula of the number of listed shares multiplied by the price quotation but has provided for a separate procedure in case the company has different categories of shares with different nominal values.
"Closed share issues are included in the company's market value from the moment they are paid and the bourse has been informed about it," the bourse said in a statement.
"If the announcement is made by the company register, then the closed issues are taken into account in the capitalisation calculation starting with Monday of each week," it said.
